Squeeze: Rust embedding experiments

1,797 handwritten digits, 64 raw pixel features, CPU only. Runtime includes graph construction, initialization and layout. Labels only color these plots. Values are medians with full seed ranges; repeated seeds are not independent datasets.

Trustworthiness uses scikit-learn's rank-based definition. Neighbor recall measures overlap and is reported separately. These results establish tradeoffs on Digits, not a universal winner.
